riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine sensitivity, a drive to perform, and self-discipline: you have to deliver the emotion, hold steady on camera, and outlast the gaps.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work trains you to give yourself over. You need empathy for the character and nerve in front of a room, plus the stamina for long stretches without work and for being picked over and cut. It suits people who are sensitive, want to perform, and can still hold discipline, and who enjoy the whole arc from rehearsal to curtain call.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Leans toward creating, connecting with people, and enterprise (Artistic A + Social S + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「敏感 + 表现欲 + 能自律」凑一块的人——情绪要交得出，镜头要稳得住，空窗要熬得过。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「把自己交出去」——既要能共情角色、控场不怯，也要扛得住长周期没活、被挑被刷。适合敏感、有表现欲、又能自律的人，也享受从排练到谢幕的全过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好创造、助人共鸣、也企业（艺术 A + 社会 S + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine exceptional rigor, calm, and fast reactions. One mistake can endanger life, so you must remain steady under pressure.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops the ability to carry responsibility in silence. It requires pharmacology and physiology knowledge, exceptional calm, and fast reactions. It suits steady, rigorous people who withstand pressure.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers Investigative, Realistic, and Social work (Investigative I + Realistic R + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「极严谨 + 冷静 + 反应快」凑一块的人——错一次危及生命，神经要绷得住。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「在沉默里扛责任」——既要懂药理生理，也要极冷静、反应快。适合沉稳、严谨、扛压强的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好研究、实际、社会（研究 I + 实际 R + 社会 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people willing to commit both body and will. Competitive sport is uncompromising: everything gained in training is either delivered or exposed in competition, with no middle ground.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The purest appeal of this career is pursuing the limit: training the body to its maximum, refining technique into muscle memory, and delivering the result before thousands of spectators. The moment of achievement answers all the hardship of training.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Artistic A + Social S

breadcrumb.label: 运动员与体育竞赛选手

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合愿意把身体和意志都押上去的人——竞技体育的纯粹在于，你练到的一切，都会在赛场上兑现或辜负你，没有中间态。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最纯粹的吸引力是「极致」：把身体练到极限、把技术磨到肌肉记忆，然后在几万人面前把训练成果兑现。那种「我做到了」的瞬间，是所有训练苦累的答案。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 艺术型 A + 社会型 S

breadcrumb.label: Environmental Science And Protection Technicians, Including Health

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine investigation, attention to detail, and field capability. Measurements must match site conditions, and technicians must balance data quality with responsibility.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work connects field conditions with data. It suits people who investigate problems, work patiently in laboratories, visit field sites, and enjoy turning measurements into usable compliance conclusions.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Practical, investigative, and process-oriented interests (Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C).

breadcrumb.label: 环境科学与保护技术人员，包括健康

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「爱探究 + 细心 + 能跑现场」凑一块的人——读数和现场要能对上，数据和责任要平衡也要会盯。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「数据与现场的连接」。适合爱琢磨、坐得住实验室、又愿意跑现场的人，也享受把一堆读数变成能用的合规结论。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、爱探究、守流程（现实 R + 研究 I + 常规 C）。

breadcrumb.label: Laborers And Freight, Stock, And Material Movers, Hand

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits healthy people willing to exert themselves and take varied assignments. Loading a truck or palletizing a warehouse produces a solid sense of accomplishment.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The value of this work is tangible. After loading a truck or palletizing a warehouse, a worker ends the day exhausted but satisfied. Direct, hardworking people who are willing to learn forklifts find fulfillment in visible results.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Conventional C

breadcrumb.label: 人工搬运、货运与物料搬运工

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「身体好、肯出力、不挑活」的人——装完一车货、码完一仓板，一天下来心里踏实。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值在「实在」：装完一车货、码完一仓板，一天下来汗流浃背但心里踏实。不绕弯子、肯出力气、又愿意学开叉车的人，会在这里找到「干完活看得见成果」的实在感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 常规型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: The most unforgettable thing in this industry is the "comrades": the brothers who walked five kilometers together, slept together in the wild, and won the mission together in drills. This is a relationship that cannot be replaced by any colleagues in the workplace. The discipline and pressure resistance provided by the army will become the foundation of your life.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This industry provides "experiences you can't find anywhere else": the starry sky seen during outdoor training, the extreme limit after a five-kilometer cross-country trip, the friendship of fellow comrades - the body and will honed by the army are the foundation for a lifetime.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Enterprising (E)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行最难忘的是「战友」：一起扛过五公里、一起野外露宿、一起在演练里把任务拿下来的兄弟，是任何职场同事都替代不了的感情。部队给的纪律和抗压能力，会成为你一生的底色。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行给的是「别处找不到的体验」：野外驻训看过的星空、五公里越野后的极限、同班战友一起扛过来的情谊——部队磨出来的身体和意志，是一辈子的底子。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 常规型 C + 企业型 E

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people committed to 0.01-millimeter precision. Accuracy is your language, and nothing feels more reassuring than confirming that a dimension meets specification.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The appeal of this career lies in precision: the 0.01 millimeter others overlook can determine success or failure in your work. If you enjoy working with metal, have the patience to stay at a machine, and feel driven to turn raw material into finished parts, you can find a craftsperson's sense of achievement here.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Investigative (I)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「对 0.01 毫米有执念」的人——精度就是你的语言，尺寸合格的那一刻，比什么都踏实。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的魅力在「精度」：别人看不出来的 0.01 毫米，在你手里是生死线。你喜欢跟金属打交道、坐得住机床、又对「把料做成件」有执念，会在这里找到手艺人的成就感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 事务型 C + 研究型 I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who keep tools close and notice work that needs doing. When the repair queue reaches zero, you know your hands prevented several problems in the building that day.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The greatest satisfaction comes from solving difficult faults. After three days without finding a leak, you locate the pipe inside a wall by listening and reading water traces. The moment the repair succeeds is deeply rewarding.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Investigative (I)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「手不离工具、眼里有活」的人——报修单清零的那一刻，你知道这栋楼今天因为你的手，少了好几起麻烦。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最有成就感的是「疑难杂症被修好」——那个查了三天没找着原因的漏水，你听声音、看水迹定位到那根墙里的管，修好那一刻，比啥都痛快。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 事务型 C + 研究型 I

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: The most moving part is continuity of care. You can support a long-term patient with diabetes from diagnosis through medication adjustment, diet, and testing. After several years, the patient trusts you more than themselves, and that enduring relationship is a unique professional asset.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The strongest appeal of this work is independent responsibility. You do not need physician approval for every common condition; you can diagnose, prescribe, and explain precautions yourself. A patient's words of thanks provide direct feedback on professional value.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Social S + Investigative I + Artistic A

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行最动人的是「连续照护」的缘分：一个糖尿病老病号，你从确诊那年起陪他调药、管饮食、盯检查，几年下来他信你胜过信自己——这种长久的信任关系，是执业护士独有的职业财富。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最吸引人的是「能独立扛事」：不用事事请示医生，遇到常见病你能自己诊断、开方、交代注意事项，患者那句「谢谢你大夫」里的信任，是职业价值最直接的反馈。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 社会型 S + 研究型 I + 艺术型 A

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits the people who bring the most warmth to medicine. They treat children, reassure entire families, and receive an irreplaceable sense of fulfillment from trust.
riasec_fit_block.interest: Pediatrics is the branch of medicine requiring exceptional patience and warmth. Children cannot describe symptoms, so physicians must ask, listen, and examine. Watching a feverish, coughing child recover and become active again creates a sense of trust and fulfillment few specialties can match.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Social S + Realistic R

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「医学里最需要温度的那部分人」——看的是孩子，安抚的是全家，被信任的满足感无可替代。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行是医学里「最需要耐心和温度」的分支：孩子不会描述症状，一切要靠医生的问、听、查。看着发烧咳嗽的孩子恢复活蹦乱跳，那种被信任的满足感是很多科室给不了的。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 社会型 S + 实际型 R

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you remain curious about pile driving and do not avoid judgment under moderate risk, becoming a pile-driver operator is worth considering.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops steadiness, accuracy, and decisiveness. It demands tactile control and close attention to command signals. It suits focused, rule-following people who tolerate noise.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers hands-on work, follows procedures, and coordinates operations (Realistic R + Conventional C + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Pile Driver Operators有持续好奇、又不排斥中风险下的判断，打桩机操作员值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「稳准狠」——既要手感，也要听指挥口令。适合专注、不怕吵、守规矩的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好动手操作、重规程、也讲调度（现实 R + 常规 C + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine dependability + steady hands + precision about dimensions. The framework must be accurate and secure, balancing safety with standards and requiring confidence at height.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career develops hand-eye coordination and responsibility. Workers must understand drawings and tie every bar correctly at height and in confined spaces. It suits dependable people who tolerate dirt and physical strain, respect structural safety, and enjoy seeing a building rise from its skeleton.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical, hands-on, and rule-based work (Realistic R + Conventional C + practical Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「踏实 + 手稳 + 对尺寸较真」凑一块的人——骨架要扎得准也要扎得牢，安全和规范要平衡也要敢上高处。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「手眼配合加责任心」——既要把图纸吃透，也要在高空和狭缝里把每根钢筋绑到位。适合踏实、不怕脏累、对结构安全有敬畏的人，也享受一栋楼从骨架长起来的成就感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、动手、也讲规则（企业 R + 常规 C + 务实 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you remain curious about semiconductor processing and accept judgment under moderate risk, this career is worth considering.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career develops discipline at microscopic scales. Technicians must understand process windows and SPC charts, tolerate repetitive focused work in cleanroom garments, and calmly identify root causes during alarms. It suits careful, procedure-oriented, composed people.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers hands-on work, investigation, and order (Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Semiconductor Processing Technicians有持续好奇、又不排斥中风险下的判断，半导体加工技术员值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「在毫厘间守纪律」——既要读得懂工艺窗口与 SPC 曲线，也要耐得住无菌服里的重复与专注，还得在报警时冷静定位根因。适合细致、守规程、不浮躁的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好实操、探究、也秩序（现实 R + 研究 I + 常规 C）。
